recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any future non-semantic cleanup of the extension definition should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by restoring the extension to core.
issue_request: Published FHIR-core Patient Care issue FHIR-3091 requested an extension allowing FamilyHistory.relation to point to the relative's Patient resource, with comments indicating the extension should support 0..* patient records.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 4805 as the initial application. The current git mirror's build@4805 commit does not show that payload, but later release history and pre-R5 core source contain StructureDefinition/familymemberhistory-patient-record with repeatable cardinality and valueReference constrained to Patient.
additional_context: FamilyHistory is now FamilyMemberHistory. FamilyMemberHistory remains active in core, but commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed resource-specific extension definitions, including familymemberhistory-patient-record, from R5 core source. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains StructureDefinition-familymemberhistory-patient-record.xml with context FamilyMemberHistory and value[x] Reference(Patient).
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Re-adding the extension to core or adding redundant local prose to FamilyMemberHistory.relationship would conflict with the current extension-pack ownership model.
